subject.title: feat: show live session activity for running tasks

question: Should this PR define OpenClaw's public per-session activity API and plugin hook contract now, or should those surfaces wait for the canonical session-activity design issue?
rationale: The patch is not only UI implementation: it creates new Gateway protocol and plugin SDK contracts whose semantics overlap an open maintainer-owned product-design issue.

options.title: Align And Repair Before Merge
options.body: Fix the selected-global scoping bug, rebase onto the current task-ledger UI, and align or trim the API/hooks to the maintainer-approved activity contract before merge.

options.title: Approve The New Contract Deliberately
options.body: Maintainers can accept the new RPC, event, and hooks as the contract, but should explicitly own the compatibility and session-state semantics before clients or plugins depend on them.

options.title: Pause Behind Canonical Design
options.body: If attention, stale-run, child-rollup, and plugin-hook semantics are still unsettled, pause or close this branch until the canonical design is settled.

recommendation.title: Align And Repair Before Merge
recommendation.body: Fix the selected-global scoping bug, rebase onto the current task-ledger UI, and align or trim the API/hooks to the maintainer-approved activity contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc owns the canonical open session-activity issue and has recent gateway/protocol history in the affected surfaces.
